NeoWork is a global outsourcing partner that connects businesses with dedicated remote professionals. We believe in building long-term careers for our team members while delivering exceptional, human-centered service for our clients. This role sits at the heart of that mission supporting a fast-growing homecare client where compassion, calm, and quick thinking matter most.

Role Overview

As an Staffing Coordinator, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a US-based homecare agency during overnight hours US hours. You will handle inbound calls from caregivers and clients, troubleshoot real-time issues, coordinate caregiver scheduling, and document each interaction clearly for the daytime team.

This is a high-empathy, high-stakes support role. Callers may be stressed, scared, or frustrated — your ability to stay calm, listen actively, and take swift action makes a real difference in people's lives.

Key Responsibilities

• Answer and manage inbound calls from caregivers and clients during overnight hours, providing responsive and professional support.

• De-escalate emotionally charged situations with empathy and composure, ensuring callers feel heard and supported.

• Problem-solve in real time — assess each situation, identify the right course of action, and follow through.

• Coordinate caregiver staffing to fill open or vacated shifts, matching availability with client needs efficiently.

• Maintain thorough, clear written logs of every call and action taken, giving the daytime team full context to continue seamlessly.

• Escalate complex or urgent situations appropriately, following established protocols.

• Build familiarity with client care plans, caregiver profiles, and agency workflows over time.

Requirements

• Confident, professional communicator over the phone clear, calm, and easy to understand.

• Demonstrated ability to de-escalate tense situations and lead interactions with empathy and patience.

• Strong written English, able to write accurate, concise call summaries and shift notes.

• Comfortable working autonomously during overnight hours with minimal supervision.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free work environment.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in homecare, caregiving, or a related healthcare support environment — especially in California.

• Familiarity with home care agency operations, caregiver scheduling, or care coordination.

• Background in customer service, a call center, or dispatch-style support roles.

Experience handling urgent or sensitive calls (e.g., medical, social services, crisis support).

﻿Employment Type: Full time

Position Purpose

The HR Administrator provides administrative and record keeping support to the Human Resources function of The Infinity Group, working under the direct line management of the HR Director and the day to day functional guidance of the HR Advisor. This role is dedicated solely to stores administered by the Teneo Administrators, and is primarily responsible for HR record keeping, correspondence support, and assistance with the preparation and tracking of employment contracts for stores within its remit.

The role is administrative in nature and does not carry responsibility for performance management, disciplinary matters, investigations or terminations. All performance related matters must be escalated to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director immediately and are not to be handled or responded to by the HR Administrator, unless the response is administrative only i.e., lunch break hours confirmation, etc.

Key Responsibilities

HR Inbox and Query Support

  • Assist the HR Advisor in monitoring and managing the HR inbox on a daily basis for Teneo administered stores, ensuring queries are acknowledged and actioned within agreed timeframes.
  • Respond to routine, administrative HR queries from employees and store managers within Teneo administered stores in a professional, clear and accurate manner.
  • Identify and immediately escalate all performance related, disciplinary, investigation or termination related queries to the HR Advisor and/or HR Director. No response is to be provided on these matters by the HR Administrator.
  • Maintain accurate records of correspondence and queries in accordance with company record keeping requirements.

﻿Records, Contract and Document Administration

  • Prepare and populate new employment contracts and contract variations for Teneo administered stores in accordance with approved templates and instructions, for checking by the HR Advisor prior to submission for approval.
  • Maintain and update contract trackers, workbooks and personnel records relevant to Teneo administered stores, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Support the tracking of contract and correspondence approval status with the Teneo Administrators, and follow up outstanding items in a timely manner under the direction of the HR Advisor.
  • Maintain accurate offboarding and personnel data in Employment Hero and ClockOn as directed.

General Administrative Support

  • Provide day to day administrative support to the HR Director, HR Advisor and broader HR team.
  • Assist with the preparation, formatting and distribution of HR correspondence and documentation as directed.
  • Maintain confidentiality of all employee and company information at all times.
  • Undertake other administrative duties as reasonably required by the HR Director or HR Advisor.

Key Selection Criteria

Essential

  • Strong administrative and organisational skills with high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Excel.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Availability to work 9.00am to 5.00pm Australian Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday, in line with the Australian business calendar, including on Philippines public holidays.
  • A strong understanding of confidentiality requirements when handling employee information.

Desirable

  • Working knowledge of the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), the National Employment Standards and the Pharmacy Industry Award.
  • General understanding of Australian human resources and industrial relations principles.
  • Familiarity with Employment Hero (Desired but not essential)
  • Familiarity with ClockOn (Desired but not essential)

Key Relationships

  • HR Director (direct report line and escalation point for all performance related matters).
  • HR Advisor (day to day functional guidance and task allocation).
  • Internal HR and payroll team members.
  • Store managers and store level personnel within Teneo administered stores.
  • Administrators (Teneo), for contract and correspondence approval purposes.

raw.description:
About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

Job Description:

The Benefits Coordination and Recovery of Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) supports Medicare beneficiaries, authorized representatives, employers, insurers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders with questions related to other health insurance coverage and Medicare’s payment responsibility.

The CSR reviews and updates beneficiary insurance information, helps determine the appropriate order of payment, and explains Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) requirements. This role requires accurate documentation, strong customer service skills, and strict compliance with Centers for Medicare (CMS), HIPAA, privacy, security, and program requirements.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Handle inbound calls concerning Medicare Coordination of Benefits and Medicare Secondary Payer matters.
  • Assist beneficiaries, authorized representatives, employers, insurers, providers, attorneys, and other approved callers.
  • Collect, verify, research, and update other health insurance information, including Employer group health plan coverage and non-group health plan coverage.
  • Apply approved Medicare Secondary Payer rules and procedures to determine whether Medicare may pay primary or secondary.
  • Accurately enter and update insurance records, call details, and supporting information.
  • Protect personally identifiable information and protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and applicable privacy and security requirements.
  • Meet established standards for quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
  • Complete required training and remain current on Medicare COB and MSP program updates.

EDUCATION / EQUIVALENT TRAINING


  • High School Graduate or equivalent required.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

EXPERIENCE


  • Six months in a call center, customer service, healthcare, health insurance or related environment.
  • Must be able to type 20 WPM, 30 WPM preferred.
  • Ability to explain insurance and Medicare information in clear, easy-to-understand language.
  • Demonstrated empathy, professionalism, active listening, and de-escalation skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry abilities.
  • Ability to navigate several applications while speaking with callers and documenting interactions.
  • Ability to work independently and protect sensitive information in a remote setting in Oklahoma City, OK.

REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS


  • Maintain a private, quiet, and secure workspace free from unauthorized individuals and interruptions.
  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet that meets technical requirements.

raw.excerpt: Votre rôleEn tant que Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultants.
raw.description:
Votre rôle

En tant que Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultants. Vous piloterez opérationnellement les missions, participerez activement au développement commercial, au marketing de l’offre et au développement de l’expertise au sein du cabinet.

Vous intervenez comme directeur de projet auprès de directions immobilières, directions des environnements de travail et directions des systèmes d’information dans la définition de leur stratégie Smart Building et dans la transformation numérique de leurs bâtiments, depuis l’expression des besoins jusqu’au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les utilisateurs.

Vos principales responsabilités

1.Développement commercial et management

  • Encadrer, accompagner et faire progresser des consultants.
  • Réalisation des rendez-vous d’avant-vente et aux phases de qualification.
  • Pilotage de la rédaction des propositions commerciales et des réponses aux appels d’offres.
  • Structurer les démarches, charges, livrables et dispositifs d’intervention.
  • Présenter les propositions aux clients et défendre les choix méthodologiques.
  • Développer des offres, méthodes, référentiels et convictions autour du Smart Building.
  • Participer à la veille technologique, réglementaire et concurrentielle.

2.Pilotage de mission de conseil et cadrage stratégique

  • Analyser les enjeux usagers, immobiliers, énergétiques, environnementaux, numériques et organisationnels des clients.
  • Construire une vision cible du bâtiment intelligent adaptée à leurs priorités et à leur patrimoine.
  • Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité Smart Building et Digital Workplace.
  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage à valeur :
    • performance énergétique ;
    • optimisation de l’occupation et des espaces ;
    • confort et qualité des environnements intérieurs ;
    • maintenance prédictive ;
    • expérience collaborateur ;
    • services aux occupants ;
    • sûreté et sécurité ;
    • pilotage multisite du patrimoine.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route, scénarios de transformation et modèles de gouvernance.
  • Contribuer à la construction des trajectoires d'ambition digitales.

3.Pilotage de conception fonctionnelle et architecture Smart Building

  • Recueillir les besoins des directions métiers, immobilières, techniques et informatiques.
  • Formaliser les cas d’usage, parcours utilisateurs et exigences fonctionnelles.
  • Participer à la définition des architectures fonctionnelles et applicatives.
  • Définir les principes d’articulation entre :
    • équipements et systèmes du bâtiment ;
    • GTB/GTC ;
    • IoT et capteurs ;
    • réseaux et connectivité ;
    • Building Operating System ou plateforme de services ;
    • BIM et BIM GEM ;
    • systèmes d’information immobiliers ;
    • outils Workplace ;
    • plateformes de données ;
    • applications destinées aux occupants.

4.Pilotage de prestation d’assistance à maîtrise d’ouvrage et pilotage de projets

  • Accompagner les clients dans la rédaction de programmes fonctionnels et de cahiers des charges.
  • Participer à la consultation et à la sélection de fournisseurs, intégrateurs et éditeurs.
  • Analyser les réponses techniques et fonctionnelles.
  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents acteurs du projet :
  • Piloter les risques, dépendances, arbitrages et plans d’action.
  • Préparer et animer les instances de gouvernance.
  • Suivre la réalisation des pilotes, démonstrateurs et déploiements.
  • Préparer les phases de recette fonctionnelle et de mise en service.
  • Vérifier l’alignement des solutions déployées avec les usages et la vision initiale.

5. Pilotage de mission de conduite du changement

  • Comprendre les attentes des occupants, exploitants et gestionnaires.
  • Concevoir des parcours de services simples et cohérents.
  • Animer des ateliers de design de services ou de co-construction.
  • Participer à la définition des modalités d’adoption des nouveaux services numériques.
  • Accompagner les équipes clientes dans l’évolution de leurs pratiques.
  • Mesurer l’usage, la satisfaction et la valeur créée après le déploiement.

Votre profil

Formation et expériences

  • Formation supérieure Bac+5, école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce, université ou formation spécialisée en immobilier, bâtiment, numérique ou systèmes d’information.
  • Expérience professionnelle de 8 ans minimum, acquise dans le conseil, l’immobilier, l’ingénierie, l’intégration de solutions ou la transformation digitale.
  • Expérience significative sur des projets Smart Building, Smart Workplace, immobilier numérique, IoT, performance énergétique ou exploitation technique.
  • Expérience de pilotage de missions, de lots ou de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.
  • Une expérience en management en cabinet de conseil constitue un atout important.

Vos qualités

  • Forte capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.
  • Aptitude à comprendre et à articuler des enjeux métiers, immobiliers et technologiques.
  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et relationnelles.
  • Capacité à animer des ateliers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction.
  • Pédagogie et capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets techniques complexes.
  • Autonomie dans la conduite des missions.
  • Esprit de conseil et orientation client.
  • Goût du travail collectif et des environnements pluridisciplinaires.
  • Capacité à structurer et sécuriser des projets complexes.
  • Curiosité pour les innovations, les usages et les évolutions du marché.
  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser des consultants

Entité

L'ambition d'Orange Business est de devenir l'intégrateur réseaux et numérique de référence en Europe, en nous appuyant sur nos forces autour des solutions de connectivité nouvelle génération, du cloud et de la cybersécurité.

Nos 30 000 femmes et hommes présents dans 65 pays, dont chaque voix compte, sont tous animés par la même détermination et le même esprit d'équipe, pour construire les solutions digitales d'aujourd'hui et de demain et créer un impact positif pour nos clients, pour leurs salariés et pour la planète.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes grâce à des projets innovants dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, l'IoT, ou encore le digital workspace et le big data.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous !

Travailler chez Orange Consulting, c'est rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine qui offre à ses collaborateurs des perspectives d'évolution claires et accessibles à travers des parcours de formations spécialement conçus par et pour nos consultants.

La direction Orange Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les institutions en France et à l'international sur leurs problématiques de transformation digitale et leurs enjeux métiers.

raw.excerpt: Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access.
raw.description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Staff Engineer (Backend) in the Platform team, you set the technical direction for the shared foundations that every Ajaib product runs on: identity, core services, API standards, observability and developer tooling. You treat the platform as a product whose customers are other engineers, solve the hardest cross-team problems, and make engineers across the company stronger. You stay hands-on where it matters most.

  • Define the technical direction and architecture for platform systems that span many teams.
  • Lead the design of scalable, secure, multi-tenant services and review critical designs from other teams.
  • Set API and contract standards across the company: versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation and documentation.
  • Lead the architecture of identity and access: authentication, authorization, token handling and service-to-service security.
  • Design for reliability: service level objectives, rate limiting, isolation between consumers, graceful degradation and disaster recovery.
  • Build the golden paths that make good engineering the easy path: service templates, shared libraries, CI/CD standards and observability defaults.
  • Architect and execute seamless, zero-downtime structural migrations across many teams, with clear timelines, tooling and support. E.g., identity providers, gateway layers across the organization using the Strangler pattern and backward-compatible proxying.
  • Identify technical risks early, weigh trade-offs and drive decisions that fit business and regulatory needs.
  • Lead investigations and root cause analysis for complex production incidents, and drive lasting improvements.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture on cross-team initiatives.
  • Mentor Senior Engineers and help grow technical leadership across the company.
  • Stay hands-on with implementation for critical components and complex problems.
  • Design and implement highly resilient, low-latency API Gateways that standardize authentication, routing, and rate-limiting across hundreds of microservices.
  • Drive the evolution of our identity platform (OAuth2, OIDC, Zero Trust) to support seamless, highly secure access patterns for millions of retail investors and internal services.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a proven record of designing and running platform or shared services used by many teams, and leading technical work across teams.
  • Languages: Highly proficient in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • System Design & Architecture: Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, multi-tenant design, reliability engineering, observability and performance optimization.
  • Security: Deep knowledge of authentication and authorization (Keycloak / Ory Stack, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS) and secure system design.
  • Data & Messaging: Deep practical experience with Kafka, Redis, and relational and NoSQL databases, including query tuning and data consistency.
  • Infrastructure: Experience designing and operating applications on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and Kubernetes.
  • Mindset: Product mindset toward internal users. Strong communication, with the ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment is a plus.
  • Proven experience migrating live, high-traffic consumer systems to modern identity providers (like Keycloak or Ory) without user disruption is a strong plus

Benefits

  • Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
  • Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
  • Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
  • Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users.

Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Transformation Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business agility, and long-term competitiveness across the insurance and investment businesses.

The role involves developing and executing the organization's transformation strategy, modernizing business models, optimizing operating structures, driving digital adoption, and leading strategic change programs. The CTO will work closely with the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team to translate corporate strategy into measurable transformation outcomes.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, financial and operational expertise, technology awareness, and strong change management capabilities, with a proven track record of delivering complex transformation initiatives in insurance, investment management, banking, or financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational effectiveness, profitability, and organizational agility.
  • Align transformation priorities with corporate strategy, market conditions, and long-term business objectives.
  • Evaluate existing business models, organizational structures, and operating processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Establish transformation objectives, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable success criteria.

Business Model & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead initiatives to modernize business models, operating structures, and service delivery frameworks.
  • Drive organizational restructuring, process redesign, and business integration initiatives.
  • Improve operational efficiency across insurance underwriting, claims, policy administration, distribution, and customer service.
  • Support transformation of investment operations, portfolio reporting, client servicing, and wealth management processes, where applicable.
  • Develop scalable operating models to support business expansion, diversification, and organizational growth.

Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead technology-enabled business transformation initiatives in collaboration with the CIO, CTO, and CDO.
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI, advanced analytics, cloud solutions, and digital platforms.
  • Modernize legacy systems, enterprise applications, and operational infrastructure.
  • Oversee transformation programs involving InsurTech, FinTech, digital insurance, and investment platforms.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable improvements in productivity, customer experience, and business performance.

Financial & Operational Performance Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce operating costs, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Lead cost transformation, process efficiency, and productivity improvement programs.
  • Establish performance management frameworks and operational KPIs.
  • Evaluate transformation business cases, financial benefits, investment requirements, and expected returns.
  • Monitor cost savings, revenue improvements, and overall financial impact of transformation initiatives.

Organizational Change Management

  • Develop and implement change management strategies to support enterprise transformation.
  • Build organizational readiness and secure leadership and employee engagement.
  • Lead communication, training, and stakeholder engagement initiatives during transformation programs.
  • Address resistance to change and promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support leadership development and workforce transformation initiatives.

Customer & Business Experience Transformation

  • Drive initiatives to improve customer journeys and service delivery across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer and commercial leadership to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and engagement.
  • Simplify customer onboarding, claims processing, policy renewals, investment transactions, and client servicing.
  • Promote customer-centric operating models and consistent service standards.
  • Use customer insights and analytics to identify transformation priorities.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Transformation

  • Ensure transformation initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Work with risk, compliance, legal, and internal audit teams to strengthen organizational controls.
  • Lead initiatives to improve regulatory reporting, risk management processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Assess transformation-related operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Establish appropriate controls and accountability throughout transformation programs.

Strategic Projects, M&A & Business Integration

  • Oversee major strategic transformation programs, including mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and post-merger integration.
  • Lead integration of business processes, systems, teams, and organizational structures following acquisitions.
  • Support new market entry, geographic expansion, and business diversification initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional transformation projects involving multiple subsidiaries and business units.
  • Track project outcomes and ensure delivery of expected strategic and financial benefits.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with the CEO, Board, executive team, and business unit heads to establish transformation priorities.
  • Lead transformation offices, program directors, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Establish transformation governance, reporting structures, and performance accountability.
  • Manage relationships with external consultants, technology partners, and implementation specialists.
  • Present transformation progress, business impact, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree in Business Strategy, Organizational Development, Finance, or Transformation Management preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, management consulting, operational excellence, or enterprise change management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior executive or leadership role overseeing large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Significant experience in insurance, banking, investment management, asset management, wealth management, or financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading complex enterprise transformation programs with measurable financial and operational outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations, investment services, financial products, and regulated business environments.
  • Experience in operating model redesign, organizational restructuring, digital transformation, and process optimization.
  • Strong financial acumen, strategic planning, and business performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills.

Preferred Certifications:

  • Prosci Change Management Certification.
  • Certified Business Transformation Professional (CBTP).
  • PMP or Program Management Professional (PgMP).

- Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.

- Agile or Scrum certifications.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation milestones.
  • Cost savings and operational efficiency improvements.
  • Revenue growth and profitability improvements resulting from transformation.
  • Reduction in process turnaround times and operational bottlenecks.
  • Successful implementation of new operating models and business processes.

- Digital adoption and automation rates.

  • Customer satisfaction and service delivery improvements.
  • Employee engagement and organizational change adoption.
  • Successful integration of acquired businesses and strategic partnerships.
  • Realization of expected transformation benefits and ROI.
  • Regulatory compliance and risk management effectiveness.
  • Delivery of transformation initiatives within approved budgets and timelines.

About Designial

Designial is a results-driven digital marketing agency and HubSpot Solutions Partner headquartered in Silicon Valley. We are expanding our global operations and are excited to launch our new India office, based in Pune. We specialize in helping US-based businesses scale by leveraging the full power of the HubSpot platform.

Position Overview

Position Overview We are seeking a talented Creative Marketing Designer with a strong eye for visual storytelling and conversion. This role is focused on static and motion design—creating high-quality visuals for digital ads, social media, emails, and landing pages.

You will work directly with our leadership to interpret marketing goals and turn them into compelling visual assets. If you are a designer who understands layout, typography, and how to design for marketing results, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ad Creative & Social Media: Design eye-catching static visuals for LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram ads that stop the scroll and drive clicks.

  • Marketing Collateral: Create high-quality assets for email marketing campaigns, eBooks, whitepapers, and sales presentations.

  • Web & Landing Pages: Design visual elements and layouts for high-converting landing pages and website banners.

  • Motion Graphics: Create engaging motion graphics and animations for social media, digital ads, and web content using the Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Performance-Informed Design: Collaborate with the marketing team to analyze the performance of creative assets, using data and A/B testing results to iterate on and improve future designs.

  • Brand Stewardship: Maintain and enforce our brand's visual identity, ensuring a high standard of creative excellence across all static and animated materials.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience:2-5 years of professional experience in graphic design, preferably in an agency or marketing team.

  • Proven Track Record: You must provide a portfolio of case studies that clearly demonstrate how your design work has achieved measurable marketing outcomes. Examples include:

  • Increased Conversion Rates: Landing pages or ads you designed that resulted in a quantifiable lift in conversions.

  • Improved Engagement: Social media graphics or videos that led to a significant increase in engagement metrics (CTR, shares, comments).

  • A/B Testing Wins: Examples of creative A/B tests you designed where your variant produced a statistically significant improvement.

  • Creative Software Proficiency: Expert proficiency across the Adobe Creative Suite, with a strong emphasis on creating both static designs (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and compelling motion graphics.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate marketing objectives into compelling creative and use data to inform design decisions.

  • Strong Foundation: Excellent understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy.

  • Portfolio: A link to an online portfolio showcasing marketing designs (ads, social posts, brochures, etc.) is required.

  • Communication: Excellent English communication skills are required for collaborating with US teams.

Bonus Points For

  • Basic video editing or motion graphics skills (Canva, After Effects, or Premiere) are a plus, but not required.

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms like HubSpot for creating and optimizing email and landing page designs.

  • Familiarity with Figma for rapid prototyping and collaboration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Opportunity to work with US clients and a Silicon Valley HQ.

  • A flexible, remote-first work environment (Pune-based candidates preferred).

  • Growth opportunities to move into a leadership role.

  • A mature and professional environment that respects deep expertise and autonomy.

To Apply

Please submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and a link to your online portfolio.

Your portfolio must include case studies with specific data that showcase the marketing results your design work has generated.

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote

Role Summary

As a Lead Learning Experience Designer, you’ll create learning experiences that help Rivian’s Sales, Service, and Delivery teams build skills, develop confidence, and deliver thoughtful customer experiences.

We’re evolving how learning experiences are designed and built. We’re looking for someone at the forefront of applying AI to learning design—someone who actively experiments, brings strong instructional judgment, and turns new capabilities into high-quality training. You’ll use AI to expand what we can create, from realistic scenarios and interactive content to games, simulations, and tools that support employees on the job.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll lead complex learning projects, partner closely with the business, and help the team develop new ways of working. Curiosity matters, along with the ability to take an idea through testing, refinement, and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Drive complete learning programs, partnering with stakeholders to identify performance needs and lead learning projects from discovery through launch and improvement.
  • Create clear, practical learning across formats, including digital courses, facilitated experiences, interactions, games, simulations, and performance support.
  • Use AI to explore, prototype, and produce high-quality learning, applying careful review for accuracy, instructional value, accessibility, and Rivian’s voice.
  • Manage scope and dependencies with partners, communicate progress, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Evolve team practices by testing new tools, sharing effective approaches, and coaching fellow designers.
  • Use feedback, assessments, and performance data to improve learning effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • A strong workplace learning portfolio demonstrating instructional judgment, creative execution, and high-quality writing.
  • Expertise in measuring learning effectiveness, skill application, and performance outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to learning design and development, with examples of finished work and a habit of testing emerging capabilities.
  • Strong grounding in adult learning, performance consulting, and accessible design, including meaningful practice and feedback.
  • Experience leading complex projects, navigating ambiguity, and influencing stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Articulate Rise 360 and Storyline, plus the ability to build beyond established formats.
  • Ability to explain design decisions, provide constructive feedback, and develop others’ skills.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $125,800 - $187,100 [Palo Alto: $149,700 to $187,100, Irvine: $137,800 to $172,200, Plymouth & Atlanta: $125,800 - 157,200]. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com. You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 11/30/26.

Technical Skills

· Strong typing and data entry skills

Work Environment

About TaskUs:

TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.

It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:

At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.


Salary Range:

per year.

Pay Transparency Statement:

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position across our US locations. The "pay scale" provided is a good faith estimate of the range the employer reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of hire. Actual salary will be determined based on various factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, experience, skills, and specific geographic location.


Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; and paid time off including vacation, sick leave, and holidays.


Application Window:

This position is expected to remain open until 12-09-2026 . We recommend that interested candidates apply within 7 days of the posting date to ensure consideration.

Job Description:

The Senior Program Manager will lead and execute TaskUs’ LX Design strategy and initiatives.


This role will bring a wealth of experience in e-learning, instructional design, and technology, demonstrating strategic leadership in driving the development and implementation of innovative and effective digital learning programs.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES


The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for the following:


  • Strategic Leadership:
    • Develop and execute a forward-thinking e-learning strategy aligned with organizational goals and objectives.
    • Provide vision and leadership in shaping the future of digital learning within the organization.

  • Program Development and Design:

    • Oversee the design and development of engaging and effective e-learning content, ensuring alignment with instructional design principles and adult learning theories.
    • Collaborate with instructional designers and subject matter experts to create high-quality digital learning experiences.

  • Technology Integration and Innovation:

    • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies and tools to enhance the effectiveness of e-learning initiatives.
    • Drive innovation in the use of technology to improve the overall learning experience.

  • Team Leadership:

    • Lead and inspire a team of e-learning professionals, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
    • Foster a collaborative and innovative work environment within the e-learning team.

  • Quality Assurance:

    • Establish and maintain high-quality standards for e-learning content, delivery, and assessments.
    • Implement rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure continuous improvement.

  • Collaboration with Stakeholders:

    • Collaborate with executive leadership, department heads, and subject matter experts to identify training needs and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
    • Communicate the impact and benefits of e-learning initiatives to organizational leaders.

  • Training Delivery and Facilitation:

    • Occasionally facilitate training sessions, modeling best practices in digital learning delivery.
    • Help ensure trainers are well-equipped and trained to deliver e-learning content effectively.

  • Assessment and Evaluation:

    • Implement assessment tools and analyze evaluation data to measure the effectiveness of e-learning programs.
    • Use data-driven insights to make continuous improvements to digital learning initiatives.

  • Reporting and Analytics:

    • Develop and maintain reporting mechanisms to track and analyze key performance indicators related to e-learning effectiveness.
    • Utilize analytics for data-driven decision-making and program improvement.

  • Continuous Learning:

    • Stay at the forefront of advancements in e-learning methodologies, technologies, and best practices.
    • Encourage and model a culture of continuous learning within the e-learning team.

The success of the a Senior Program Manager is measured through:


  • Learning outcomes
  • Employee engagement
  • Effectiveness of training programs
  • Performance improvement

Disclaimer: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Employees may be required to perform any other job-related duties as requested by their supervisor. All requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability.



EDUCATION


Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Systems Design or any related field is a plus, but not a requirement.

WORK EXPERIENCE


At least 5 years experience in the following:


    • Mentoring teams in the LX Design space
    • Defining measurable training goals and learning objectives (in all three learning domains)
    • Actively practicing instructional design methodologies in a fast-paced environment
    • Designing learner-centered training programs and developing related training materials
    • Developing appropriate learning assessment strategies and instruments

TECHNICAL SKILLS


  • E-Learning Authoring Tools:
    • Proficiency in using industry-standard e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, or similar tools to create interactive and engaging digital content.

  • Learning Management Systems (LMS):
    • Familiarity with learning management systems to manage, deliver, and track e-learning courses. Knowledge of popular LMS platforms like Moodle, Blackboard, Canvas, or similar systems.

  • Multimedia Development:
    • Skills in multimedia development, including graphic design, video editing, and audio production to enhance the visual and auditory components of e-learning courses.

  • Adaptive Learning Technologies:
    • Awareness of adaptive learning technologies that personalize the learning experience based on individual learner needs.

  • E-Learning Standards and Protocols:
    • Understanding of e-learning standards such as SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) and xAPI (Experience API) to ensure interoperability and tracking capabilities.

  • User Experience (UX) Design:
    • Familiarity with UX design principles to create e-learning experiences that are user-friendly and engaging.

  • Security Awareness:
    • Understanding of security considerations in e-learning, including secure access, data protection, and compliance with privacy regulations.

  • Project Management Tools:
    • Proficiency in project management tools for planning, organizing, and tracking the progress of e-learning projects.

OTHER SKILLS


  • Makes logical decisions through key facts, explores alternatives, and proposes quality solutions
  • Communicates information and ideas clearly, and concisely, verbally and in writing
  • Interacts with peers, management, and other departments in a professional manner
  • Fosters a positive and productive work environment, with the ability to lead, build teams, and motivate staff
  • Has strong organizational and interpersonal management skills
  • Manages time effectively and efficiently

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Job Title: Systems Engineer - Monitoring & OperationsJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: NoneType of Travel: None* * *

The Opportunity:

The Systems Engineer will monitor system health, analyze logs and alerts, investigate anomalies, take corrective actions, coordinate incident response activities, and drive continuous improvements to operational processes. The ideal candidate possesses strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure Monitoring & Operations
    • Monitor enterprise systems, applications, servers, databases, cloud services, and network infrastructure using approved monitoring platforms.
    • Review system dashboards, alerts, and performance metrics to identify potential issues before they impact operations.
    • Ensure system availability, reliability, and operational readiness across all supported environments.
    • Perform daily operational checks and health assessments of critical infrastructure.
  • Log Analysis & Event Management
    • Review and analyze system, application, security, and network logs to identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues.
    • Investigate alerts generated by monitoring and logging tools.
    • Correlate events from multiple systems to determine root causes and operational impacts.
    • Escalate issues according to established incident management procedures.
  • Incident Response & Troubleshooting
    • Serve as a first responder for infrastructure and application-related incidents.
    • Diagnose and resolve operational issues affecting system performance, availability, or security.
    • Execute documented remediation procedures and recovery actions.
    • Coordinate with engineering, cybersecurity, networking, and application teams during incident response activities.
    • Support major incident management efforts and provide timely status updates.
  • System Health & Performance Management
    • Monitor capacity, performance, and utilization of infrastructure components.
    • Identify degradation trends and recommend corrective actions.
    • Perform routine maintenance activities and system validations.
    • Support patching, upgrades, and system lifecycle activities.
    • Recommend improvements to increase reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement
    • Develop and maintain operational runbooks and standard operating procedures.
    • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive monitoring and operational tasks.
    • Assist in implementing monitoring improvements, dashboards, and alert optimization.
    • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
  • Documentation & Reporting
    • Maintain accurate operational documentation and system inventories.
    • Document incidents, troubleshooting activities, and resolution steps.
    • Generate system health, availability, and performance reports.
    • Track recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions.

Qualifications:

Required:


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise systems, infrastructure, or network operations.
  • Experience monitoring production environments and responding to operational incidents.
  • Experience reviewing logs and troubleshooting infrastructure-related issues.
  • Knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as:
    • Splunk
    • SolarWinds
    • Datadog
    • Dynatrace
    • Azure Monitor
    • Nagios
    • Grafana
    • Prometheus
  • Experience with log aggregation and analysis tools.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of ITIL concepts including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
  • Basic scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

$63,300-$129,700

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to take ownership of our online lead generation strategy and help drive measurable business growth.

This is a hands-on role focused on managing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns, improving organic search visibility, and developing strategies for emerging AI-powered search platforms. You’ll be responsible for building campaigns, analyzing performance, identifying growth opportunities, and improving the overall return on marketing investment.

The ideal candidate combines strong Google Ads and SEO expertise with analytical thinking and a practical understanding of AI search optimization. Most importantly, you know how to turn marketing activity into qualified leads and profitable customer acquisition.

What You’ll Own

Google Ads & Paid Advertising

  • Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, and remarketing.
  • Conduct keyword research and improve PPC campaign structure, targeting, bidding strategies, and ad copy.
  • Optimize landing pages to improve campaign performance and conversions.
  • Monitor key metrics, including cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, ROAS, impression share, and search terms.
  • Identify wasted advertising spend and implement improvements to campaign efficiency.

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

  • Develop and execute organic SEO strategies to improve search visibility and generate qualified leads.
  • Manage technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO activities.
  • Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify valuable search opportunities.
  • Develop content strategies based on search intent and business priorities.
  • Improve rankings for relevant, high-value international moving and logistics searches.

AI Search Optimization (GEO / AEO)

  • Develop strategies to improve brand visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms.
  • Improve how the company's brand and content are discovered, referenced, and recommended by AI search tools.
  • Research and test emerging Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and LLM optimization strategies.
  • Create content strategies that support visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
  • Monitor emerging AI search trends and identify practical opportunities to improve brand visibility.

Website Optimization & Analytics

  • Collaborate with developers to improve landing pages, website structure, page speed, schema markup, and technical SEO.
  • Ensure accurate conversion tracking and attribution across marketing channels.
  • Build dashboards and reports that clearly track leads, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and marketing ROI.
  • Identify opportunities to improve website performance and conversion rates.
  • Explore new digital channels and lead-generation opportunities.
  • Use AI and automation tools to improve marketing research, content workflows, analysis, and campaign performance.

Performance Analysis & Lead Generation

  • Focus on generating qualified leads and improving profitable customer acquisition.
  • Identify which keywords, campaigns, and organic pages generate actual customer inquiries.
  • Analyze campaign spending and identify opportunities to reduce acquisition costs.
  • Evaluate competitor performance and recommend strategies to improve market visibility.
  • Use performance data to make informed marketing decisions and continuously improve results.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience.
  • Demonstrable experience managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns.
  • Strong knowledge of PPC strategy, campaign structure, bidding, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Strong understanding of technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO.
  • Experience with SEO tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency in keyword research and competitor analysis.
  • Experience with conversion tracking, attribution, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Experience running lead-generation campaigns with a focus on measurable business results.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for marketing research, analysis, automation, and content creation.
  • Understanding of AI search optimization, GEO, AEO, or how brands gain visibility in generative search.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage deadlines without constant supervision.
  • Willingness to learn, test, and adapt to emerging AI marketing technologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing international moving, logistics, freight forwarding, transportation, or relocation services.
  • Experience working with other high-value service businesses.
  • Proven success improving lead quality, reducing acquisition costs, and increasing marketing ROI.
  • Experience developing SEO and paid advertising strategies for competitive markets.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are a hands-on marketer who can build, manage, and optimize campaigns independently.
  • You focus on qualified leads and customer acquisition rather than vanity metrics such as traffic and impressions.
  • You understand how to connect marketing performance with actual business results.
  • You can identify underperforming campaigns, investigate the reasons, and take action to improve them.
  • You are analytical, proactive, and comfortable making data-driven decisions.
  • You enjoy experimenting with new AI search strategies and marketing technologies.
  • You communicate clearly, take ownership of your work, and consistently follow through.

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased volume of qualified leads from paid and organic channels.
  • Improved cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
  • Stronger Google Ads performance and more efficient advertising spend.
  • Improved organic rankings for high-value search terms.
  • Increased brand visibility across AI-powered search platforms.
  • Accurate conversion tracking and clear marketing performance reporting.
  • Consistent improvements in lead generation and overall marketing ROI.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Cardinal Health’s Data Office organization empowers the enterprise with trusted, high-quality data to make informed decisions and achieve strategic goals by enabling a data-driven ecosystem where data is a strategic asset.​


The Data Management & Governance function serves as the operational backbone and quality engine of the Data Office. The team acquires, standardizes, and protects enterprise and third-party data to power clinical, commercial, and financial decisions while meeting rigorous regulatory and legal standards. Through clear guidelines, quality metrics, and policy enforcement, the team ensures enterprise data remains trusted, secure, and audit ready.


The Senior Advisor, Data Management & Governance leverages advanced clinical pharmacotherapy knowledge, regulatory acumen, and data stewardship principles to oversee enterprise pharmaceutical master data assets. This role is accountable for clinical and regulatory classifications, alternative logic, formulary alignments, and the procurement and integration of third-party data. By driving cross-functional data governance and quality frameworks, this role ensures data flowing across procurement, billing, inventory, and dispensing pipelines is clinically validated, compliant, and operationalized for decision making.


Responsibilities:

  • Establish, standardize, and govern critical clinical and product attributes across the master data lifecycle
  • Author and maintain data dictionaries, business rules, policies, standards, and validation logic to ensure data integrity during item setup, maintenance, and system conversions
  • Lead the strategic alignment of product attributes with industry-standard clinical vocabularies
  • Manage clinical, regulatory, commercial, and reimbursement inquiries and execute resolution activities
  • Resolve complex data exceptions, discrepancies, and cross-reference mapping errors
  • Evaluate regulatory changes and manufacturer notices to assess their operational, clinical, and data impact
  • Oversee the procurement, ingestion, transformation, linkage, and maintenance of third-party data and associated reference data
  • Collaborate and partner with business leaders to translate strategic objectives and business process and regulatory requirements into scalable solutions across multiple domains (e.g., CSMP, QRA, Finance, Sourcing, Revenue Management, IT, Commercial Technologies, Customer Success, and Account Management)
  • Validate external data for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness and convert unstructured data to structured data for ease of use
  • Create data views and reports that promote data quality, business insights, and enable accuracy and efficiency for downstream users
  • Lead and support data modernization initiatives
  • Subject matter expert for clinical and product datasets

Qualifications:

  • Must have an active, unrestricted Registered Pharmacist (RPh) license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, State of Ohio, preferred
  • Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy (B.S. Pharm) from an accredited college of pharmacy preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • 8+ years in hospital or retail pharmacy, both preferred
  • Experience in clinical pharmacy practice, pharmacy informatics, healthcare data stewardship, or pharmaceutical supply chain master data
  • Prior experience with pharmaceutical compendia
  • Direct experience with enterprise master data management systems or ERP solutions
  • Strong understanding of healthcare and pharmaceutical coding systems
  • Proficiency using analytical tools to develop creative and innovative insights with high business value
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Proven track record of translating complex clinical nuances into precise technical and operational data requirements

Anticipated salary range: $106,700 - $152,400

Bonus eligible: Yes

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 12/31/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

raw.description:
AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits - not speculative staffing banks.

AlphaGov is building a bench of energy engineers who measure and verify savings from building efficiency, weatherization, heat pump, and electrification programs for state energy offices, public service departments, and utilities. You would lead the engineering side of program evaluations, from site measurement to savings calculations.

We confirm scope, schedule, and fee with you before any engagement begins.

What you'll do

  • Develop measurement and verification plans using IPMVP options and program technical reference manuals (TRMs)
  • Conduct or oversee site visits, metering, and data logging for heating, cooling, and building envelope measures
  • Build building energy models and engineering savings calculations for thermal and electric measures
  • Review TRM algorithms, deemed savings values, and baseline assumptions
  • Calibrate engineering estimates against billing and interval data with evaluation analysts
  • Write the engineering sections of evaluation reports and answer regulator questions
  • Contribute qualifications and past-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when you authorize naming

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • At least 5 years in energy engineering, energy auditing, or M&V for efficiency or electrification programs
  • Building energy modeling experience (for example eQUEST, EnergyPlus, BEopt, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of IPMVP and technical reference manuals
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • PE, CMVP, or CEM credential
  • Residential retrofit, weatherization, or heat pump program experience
  • Vermont, New York, or New England program experience

Job Title: Sr. Director, Digital Pricing Strategy

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is undergoing a significant customer and business model transformation, driven by the acquisition of Intelerad and the expansion of innovative software, SaaS, and cloud-based solutions. These solutions are designed to address some of the most complex challenges in the healthcare industry.

This role is a critical leadership position supporting GE HealthCare’s transition to a SaaS-first software business model. As part of a global, cross-functional environment, the Sr. Director of Digital Pricing Strategy will define and operationalize pricing and monetization strategies across newly integrated organizations. This role will play a key part in aligning commercial, finance, and product teams while driving profitable growth and long-term scalability.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing Design

Develop and lead global pricing strategies for SaaS and cloud-based offerings, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives across AI, digital, and enterprise software solutions. Drive pricing transformation as core products evolve to a cloud-first model.

SaaS Monetization & Business Model Transformation

Lead the design and implementation of modern SaaS monetization strategies, including ARR growth, net revenue retention (NRR), attach rate expansion, price realization, and margin optimization. Drive the evolution from legacy licensing models to scalable subscription, consumption, and platform-based pricing models.

Post-Acquisition Integration & Change Leadership

Partner across legacy organizations to harmonize pricing strategies, tools, and operating models following the Intelerad acquisition. Lead change management efforts to ensure adoption of new pricing frameworks and foster alignment across commercial, finance, and product teams.

Market Awareness & Competitive Intelligence

Analyze market trends, competitor pricing, and customer insights to inform pricing strategy. Stay current on industry trends, regulatory environments, and best practices in SaaS and healthcare software markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure pricing strategies align with go-to-market objectives. Engage early in product development cycles to incorporate customer value and market needs into pricing models.

Product Pricing & Enterprise Structuring

Partner with product teams to design scalable pricing structures across multi-product portfolios. Ensure pricing models support enterprise agreements spanning multiple offerings, customer segments, and healthcare modalities.

Platform & Advanced Pricing Models

Develop and implement modern SaaS pricing approaches, including platform pricing, subscription models, consumption-based pricing, and outcome-based pricing for strategic enterprise customers. Utilize advanced pricing analytics, segmentation, and elasticity modeling.

Deal Structuring & Commercial Execution

Provide hands-on leadership in structuring complex enterprise deals, including pricing, packaging, and multi-solution offerings. Translate pricing strategy into actionable sales tools, guidance, and scalable frameworks to support field execution.

Performance Forecasting & Financial Partnership

Collaborate with Finance to develop revenue forecasts, financial models, and KPI tracking frameworks for SaaS products. Ensure pricing decisions directly support margin expansion and long-term profitability.

Executive Communication & Reporting

Develop clear, data-driven pricing dashboards and insights for executive leadership. Present pricing strategies, forecasts, and performance metrics to senior stakeholders.

Change Management & Enablement

Lead organizational adoption of pricing strategies through change management, training, and communication. Equip Sales and Commercial teams with tools and frameworks to support complex SaaS transactions.

Annual Pricing Strategy

Design scalable pricing adjustments and annual increase strategies based on market data, customer value, and financial performance, ensuring measurable impact to revenue growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in pricing strategy, monetization, or related fields, preferably within SaaS or cloud-based environments
  • Proven experience building or transforming pricing models in SaaS or subscription-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success driving monetization strategy, including ARR, NRR, and margin optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate market data into actionable pricing strategies
  • Extensive experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and pricing analytics tools
  • Experience structuring complex, enterprise-level deals and commercial agreements
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or healthcare technology
  • Experience in late-stage SaaS, cloud-first, or private equity-backed organizations
  • Exposure to post-M&A integration and business transformation initiatives
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and global commercial teams

Leadership Expectations & Work Environment

  • Operates as a strategic leader without direct reports initially, with potential to build a team over time
  • Thrives in a highly cross-functional, global environment
  • Demonstrates strong influence across Product, Finance, and Commercial leadership
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure in a transforming organization
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution, particularly in deal structuring and pricing implementation

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to help define pricing and monetization strategy for GE HealthCare’s evolution into a SaaS-first enterprise. The role sits at the center of a major post-acquisition transformation and will directly impact revenue growth, margin expansion, and how digital solutions are delivered to healthcare systems globally.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $140,000.00-$210,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.
