The Associate Director, Formulary Operations Management is responsible for the development, implementation, maintenance, and governance of pharmacy formularies and utilization management strategies across lines of business. This role partners with clinical, operational, regulatory, analytics, and product teams to ensure formulary decisions are accurately implemented, compliant with regulatory requirements, and aligned with organizational goals.

The Associate Director, Formulary Operations Management requires a solid understanding of how organizational capabilities interrelate across departments and serves as a key leader in translating formulary strategy into operational excellence.

The Associate Director, Formulary Management leads formulary operations implementation and maintenance activities, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, business objectives, and member needs.


This role collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to implement formulary strategies, oversee utilization management initiatives, support regulatory submissions, and ensure accurate implementation of formulary and coverage decisions. Associate Director is accountable for formulary operations workflow, quality, capacity, training, reporting, issue resolution, and people leadership.


This role will work during standard Eastern Time business hours.

  • Oversee operational implementation of formulary changes, including coordination with clinical, configuration, product, and operational teams.
  • Support the development and execution of utilization management programs, including, but not limited to, prior authorization, step therapy, quantity limits, and coverage

raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

As Senior Occupancy Planner, you will be responsible for providing strategic occupancy planning expertise, leveraging a deep understanding of our client’s space supply and demand to develop scenario and occupancy plans for our client's portfolio in a designated region.

Fostering relationships

You'll foster critical relationships between various individuals and organizations, including:

  • Corporate Real Estate to review and resolve planning forecast requirements, concerns, and issues,
  • Business Unit leadership to collect headcount forecasts and resolve headcount forecast discrepancies between their numbers and those collected at the group level,
  • Corporate Finance group to gather top-down headcount and growth projections,
  • Project management to review planning strategies that drive construction projects and support the implementation of these projects,
  • Move coordination and facility management teams to review and approve moves, develop migration plans, and conduct facility audits, and
  • Other members of the occupancy planning team to ensure the development of portfolio strategy plans across separate locations.

Driving optimal occupancy planning solutions

Your primary focus areas for this role will be managing the development of occupancy plans, sequencing group-level and individual moves, and resolving planning issues identified during client planning sessions. You will ensure the alignment of planning with corporate guidelines and that all scenarios maximize the use of space. You will recommend, educate, and enforce space policies/standards, procedures, and protocols, notify the client of customer-requested exceptions, and, as necessary, assist in developing site-specific Planning Strategies with Senior Leadership. You will be a Subject Matter Expert in the client's workplace program and in using data to drive solutions that increase productivity. You will be a leader in the Occupancy Planning and account team, modelling superior client relationship management and strategic thinking.

Reporting

One of your major requirements will be to get familiar with space utilization methods and the presentation of utilization data. Interacting with organizational leadership, you will identify space requirements and prepare and update project status reports on actual versus projected seat demand at the building level. In addition, you will report on current supply and capacity, forecast inventory changes as required, and work with the client to reconcile any discrepancies from top-down projections.

Remote –Warsaw, POL

Job Description:

Investigates, analyzes, and responds to cybersecurity incidents within a network environment or enclave.

Uses data collected from a variety of cyber defense tools and platforms, including intrusion detection systems (IDS), firewalls, endpoint protection technologies, network traffic logs, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365, to analyze events and mitigate threats.


Monitors, investigates, and responds to security alerts, incidents, and suspicious activity across enterprise environments using Microsoft security technologies and other security monitoring tools.


Interprets, analyzes, and reports all events and anomalies in accordance with computer network directives, including initiating, responding to, documenting, and reporting discovered incidents.


Evaluates, tests, recommends, coordinates, monitors, and maintains cybersecurity policies, procedures, and systems, including access management for hardware, firmware, software, and cloud services.


Ensures cybersecurity plans, controls, processes, standards, policies, and procedures are aligned with organizational and regulatory security requirements.


Identifies security risks and exposures, determines the causes of security violations, and recommends corrective actions to prevent recurrence and improve organizational security posture.

Supports the implementation and administration of Microsoft Purview solutions, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Protection, Sensitivity Labels, Insider Risk Management, and data governance controls.

Develops techniques and procedures for conducting cybersecurity risk assessments, compliance audits, threat investigations, and the evaluation and testing of hardware, firmware, software, and cloud technologies for potential security impacts.

Investigates and responds to security incidents involving unauthorized access, malware, phishing, data exfiltration, insider threats, fraud, attacks, or information leaks.

Collaborates with technical and business stakeholders to improve detection capabilities, incident response processes, and overall security operations effectiveness.

May coach and provide guidance to less-experienced professionals.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Technical Training, Certification(s), or Degree, and 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, security operations, incident response, cyber defense, or related disciplines.

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, and Defender for Cloud Apps.
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Insider Risk Management, Information Protection, and Data Lifecycle Management.
  • Experience investigating security incidents across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and collaboration environments.
  • Knowledge of threat hunting, incident response, log analysis, and detection engineering.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized Remote Bookkeeper to support the finance team with day-to-day accounting and administrative tasks for a property management portfolio.

In this role, you’ll work primarily with AppFolio and QuickBooks Online to manage accounts payable and receivable, process payments, reconcile bank and trust accounts, maintain accurate financial records, and support month-end reporting.

You’ll handle a high volume of daily transactions and work closely with the Director of Finance, while communicating with vendors, tenants, property owners, and internal team members. The ideal candidate has bookkeeping experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial tasks independently in a remote environment.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Payable

  • Review, code, and enter vendor invoices in AppFolio.
  • Create in-house maintenance invoices and bill tenants for tenant-caused repairs.
  • Follow up on past-due invoices and respond to vendor payment inquiries.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s, insurance documents, and payment methods.
  • Prepare 1099 forms.

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Ledgers

  • Post and reconcile rent receipts, deposits, and chargebacks.
  • Prepare move-out security deposit dispositions within required timelines.
  • Track overdue tenant payments and follow established collection policies.
  • Maintain accurate collections logs and tenant account records.

Bank & Trust Reconciliations

  • Reconcile operating, rent trust, and security deposit trust accounts daily.
  • Investigate and resolve outstanding items, non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions, and unmatched payments.
  • Ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.

Month-End & Administrative Support

  • Generate month-end reports and gather supporting documentation for the Director of Finance.
  • Process owner distributions once approved.
  • Monitor the finance inbox and respond to or route inquiries from owners, tenants, and staff.
  • Keep owner, tenant, and vendor contact and payment information up to date.

Company Bookkeeping – QuickBooks Online

  • Record receipts and expenses for company entities.
  • Review and accurately categorize financial transactions.
  • Prepare weekly billable-hours reports.
  • Support commission and payroll data preparation.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting support, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.
  • Proficiency in AppFolio and QuickBooks Online.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Strong data entry skills with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of daily transactions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with owners, tenants, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and follow established procedures.
  • High level of professionalism and commitment to confidentiality when handling financial information.

Nice to Have

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience in property management accounting.
  • Familiarity with tenant ledgers, owner distributions, and security deposit accounting.
  • Experience maintaining vendor records and preparing 1099 forms.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable handling detailed, repetitive financial tasks.
  • You can manage multiple accounting priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • You take ownership of daily responsibilities and follow established processes.
  • You proactively investigate discrepancies and follow up on unresolved transactions.
  • You communicate professionally and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.
  • You are reliable, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Vendor invoices, payments, and tenant transactions are processed accurately and on time.
  • Bank and trust accounts are reconciled daily, with discrepancies investigated promptly.
  • Tenant ledgers, vendor records, and financial information remain accurate and up to date.
  • Month-end reports and supporting documents are prepared reliably.
  • Owner distributions and other financial tasks are completed according to approval procedures.
  • The Director of Finance receives consistent and dependable bookkeeping support.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to replace repetitive manual tasks across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) with reliable, reusable automation. The role focuses on automating patch management across the environment using tools such as Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Windows, Linux, storage, and backup teams to understand patch management cycles and identify opportunities to automate patching activities.
  • Analyze ServiceNow patching tickets to identify recurring manual tasks and quantify their frequency and effort across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Prioritize patch management automation opportunities based on patch severity, operational risk, and impact across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles to automate patch management procedures
  • Use Terraform to maintain repeatable infrastructure configurations that support patch management workflows.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely deploy patch management automation to production.
  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates required by automated patching workflows through HashiCorp Vault.
  • Use JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure artifacts used by patch management pipelines.
  • Validate automated patching workflows against existing manual procedures before replacing manual patching activities.
  • Track and report on patch automation coverage and reductions in manual patching effort and related ticket volume across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Document patch management procedures, Ansible playbooks, and pipeline configurations for Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Regularly review patching ticket trends to identify recurring manual work and keep the patch automation backlog current.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, patch management, or related engineering roles, including patching automation.
  • Hands-on experience using Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault to support production patch management workflows.
  • Experience analyzing patching tickets and incident data in ServiceNow or a similar ITSM tool to identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve patch delivery.
  • Ability to gather patching requirements from operations teams and translate patch cycles and procedures into repeatable workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems administration, storage, and backup operations, with experience supporting patch management across these environments.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar languages to automate patching tasks and validation.

Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Senior Web Engineer II in the Platform team, you build the web foundations that every Ajaib product team builds on: the design system and component library, shared packages, sign-in and session handling in the browser, and the build and release tooling. You own these foundations from design to production, treat other engineers as your customers, and help the engineers around you do better work.

  • Design, build and maintain shared web foundations: component library, design system, shared packages and the application shell.
  • Own features end to end: technical design, implementation, testing, release and support for the teams that use them.
  • Keep shared packages stable: clear APIs, semantic versioning, changelogs, migration guides and safe deprecation.
  • Build accessible, themeable, well-documented components that product teams can adopt without custom work.
  • Build and improve secure sign-in, session and token handling on the web, working with backend and Security teams.
  • Improve build speed, CI/CD pipelines, monorepo tooling and release automation for all web teams.
  • Set and measure performance budgets and quality standards, such as Core Web Vitals, bundle size and accessibility checks.
  • Write maintainable, well-tested code and give thoughtful code reviews.
  • Investigate production issues from error monitoring and feedback from product teams, and ship lasting fixes.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and share good web practices across teams.
  • Own the integration of our centralized identity platform (OAuth2/OIDC) into all web properties, ensuring zero-trust session management and protecting against modern web vulnerabilities.
  • Establish and enforce company-wide frontend instrumentation standards. Build the core telemetry packages (logging, tracing, error boundaries) that product teams use to monitor their apps in production.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional web engineering, including building shared libraries, design systems or tooling used by several teams.
  • Languages & Frameworks: Strong in TypeScript and JavaScript; deep experience with React and a modern framework such as (deep knowledge in App Router / Pages Router is a must); strong component design.
  • Architecture & Tooling: Experience with monorepos, bundlers, package publishing and build performance.
  • Quality: Solid experience with unit, integration, visual and end-to-end testing, CI/CD and error monitoring.
  • Performance & Security: Strong in browser performance profiling, accessibility and web security, including authentication on the web. Deep understanding of browser mechanics, HTTP headers (CSP, CORS), cookie security policies, and token lifecycles.
  • Mindset: Ownership mindset, clear communication and a service attitude toward internal users. Experience in fintech or another regulated, high-traffic consumer product is a plus.

Benefits

  • Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
  • Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
  • Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
  • Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users.

raw.description:
Who You’ll Work With

As a Layer1 software engineer, you will get to work on software that manages the physical layer, where packets meet the outside world. Stable and reliable physical connectivity is critical for any network and that is your challenge. You will get to write control software that brings to life everything from the ubiquitous 1GBASE-T connectors to 400G long reach optics that provide fiber connectivity across continents. Your software will need to work across a wide variety of forwarding engines, connectors and interface chips called gearboxes, which allow our hardware platforms to support diverse physical connectivity options within a product family. You will build instrumentation and telemetry tools that track physical link health parameters reported by the Layer1 components and enable operators to monitor and troubleshoot their links effectively. You will also work closely with our Optics teams to define standards for new media and bring them to market.

Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Layer1 software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.

Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from Layer1 to other areas, if you like.

What You’ll Do

  • Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new Layer1 features.
  • Architect, design and manage the development of these features.
  • Develop and maintain features using C, C++ and Python, review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.
  • Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new Layer1 components like Phys and Transceivers to market.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing Layer1 components.
  • Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.
  • Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.
  • Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.
  • Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment.
  • BS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering + 8 years experience, or equivalent work experience
  • Expert knowledge of C or C++ and Python.
  • Knowledge of UNIX or Linux
  • Knowledge of digital communication technologies like modulation and signal encoding schemes is a plus.
  • Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus
  • Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus
  • Applied understanding of software engineering principles
  • Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.
  • Ability to work in small teams.

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to join our Public Sector, Defence and Defence Industrial Base team as a trusted senior technical pre-sales partner to our Account Executives and channel partners across the UK and Ireland. In this role, you will help government departments, defence customers, and defence industrial base partners understand how our storage and data platform solutions solve mission critical business and technical challenges, and you will play a key part in advancing opportunities from discovery through technical validation and close.

This is a highly collaborative, customer facing role for a senior technical professional with strong storage fundamentals, a consultative mindset, and the confidence to engage in technical conversations with senior stakeholders across government, defence, and industry. A meaningful part of the role is also enabling partner SEs so they can independently position and scale our solutions across the public sector and defence market.

This role is remote based. There is an expectation that you will travel regularly across the UK and Ireland to meet customers and partners in person, including on-site visits to government, defence, and defence industrial base locations as required.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives on public sector and defence opportunities, joining discovery conversations, territory planning, shaping solution direction, and helping move deals forward through the funnel.

We are seeking a motivated AI Architect - Pre-sales to join our sales team, specializing in the AI security space. As an AI Architect- Pre-sales, you will be instrumental in driving the adoption of our innovative AI security solutions, working closely with our sales representatives and prospective clients to understand their security needs, demonstrate the capabilities of our products, and architect tailored solutions that address their unique requirements. Your technical expertise, combined with strong communication and interpersonal skills, will be essential in building and maintaining relationships with clients and effectively articulating the value proposition of our AI security offerings.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  1. Technical Consultation: Collaborate with the sales team to engage with clients and prospects, conducting technical discussions to understand their security challenges, objectives, and infrastructure requirements.
  2. Product Demonstrations: Conduct product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the features, functionalities, and benefits of our AI security solutions to prospective clients.
  3. Solution Design: Architect customized security solutions tailored to client needs, leveraging your understanding of cybersecurity principles, AI technologies, and industry best practices.
  4. Proof of Concept (PoC): Lead the development and execution of proof of concept (PoC) projects, working closely with clients to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of our solutions in their environment.
  5. Technical Support: Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to clients, addressing inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring a smooth deployment and integration process.
  6. Training and Enablement: Conduct training sessions and workshops for clients and internal stakeholders, empowering them with the knowledge and skills to effectively utilize our AI security products.
  7. Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and research, to provide feedback from the field and contribute to product enhancements and roadmap.
  8. Market Intelligence: Stay informed about market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive landscape in the AI security space, continuously enhancing your knowledge and expertise.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Proven experience in a pre-sales or post-sales solution architecture role.
  • Proficient with Linux (familiarity with GNU, Bash, etc.).
  • Moderate to advanced cloud experience (including hands-on experience with IaC).

  • Proficiency in articulating technical concepts and value propositions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with conducting product demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), and technical presentations.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with a passion for technology and a drive for continuous learning and development.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to client sites and industry events.

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We’re moving at (what feels like) the speed of light. HiddenLayer is a venture-backed company and recently closed a $50M funding round led by M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and Moore Strategic Ventures.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

raw.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

​

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We're looking for a staff software engineer to be a technical leader on our Metadata team, which owns the metadata layer of the dbt platform — the discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history services that let customers understand, trust, and act on what their data is doing.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll contribute to the technical direction for the team. You'll own the architecture of major subsystems, lead complex projects that span multiple engineers, and raise the bar for design and code quality across the team. You'll spend your time on the hardest technical problems, and multiply the team through design reviews, coaching, and mentorship.

This is a full-time, fully remote position.

Technologies You'll Use

Python, GraphQL, Postgres, Snowflake, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Datadog

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, team-level projects across the Metadata services, coordinating development across multiple engineers
  • Independently design and develop the architecture of new subsystems, and own team-level subsystems end to end
  • Use AI tooling and agents — across development and SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, post-mortems, and test plans
  • Review and approve technical designs, ensuring they meet a high quality bar, and identify design deficiencies before they ship
  • Drive technical initiatives across the team's responsibility areas — discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history
  • Set and uphold design, architecture, and coding best practices, and hold teammates accountable for code quality
  • Coach and mentor engineers, demonstrably improving the quality of code across the team
  • Write technical specs, document common components, and keep the team accountable for necessary project documentation
  • Fix and optimize critical parts of the codebase, drive incident follow-through, and advance the reliability and performance of the services you own
  • Participate periodically in the on-call rotation

Skills We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, team-scope technical work to completion
  • Deep expertise designing and owning subsystems in distributed, cloud-based systems
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction for a team and drive multi-engineer initiatives across an area of ownership
  • Excellent design and architecture judgment; identifies design flaws in existing systems and proposes sound solutions with clear trade-offs
  • Writes exemplary, well-tested code that serves as a model for others, and reliably estimates and delivers sprint to sprint
  • Strong track record of raising quality through code review, coaching peers, and enforcing accepted engineering practices
  • Experience partnering with QE on test strategy and owning operational health — incidents, post-mortems, reliability, and performance
  • Proficiency in a modern backend or systems language such as Python, Java, C++, or C#
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and managing dev infrastructure
  • Fluent in using AI code assistants and coding agents to generate and investigate code, and conversational AI (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to author, review, and synthesize SDLC artifacts — and able to model those practices for a team

Bonus Skills

  • Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based data platforms
  • Experience architecting metadata, catalog, lineage, or discovery/search systems
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and high-throughput, multi-tenant data services
  • Familiarity with the analytics engineering workflow and the dbt ecosystem

$183,000 - $245,000 USD

  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*

raw.description:
At Blink, we constantly have new opportunities, so if you are interested in working for Blink, apply, and we will contact you if a position that fits your experience comes in. Blink UX is looking for Forward Deployed Engineers interested in our project-based contractor pool. Project-based contracts vary in length; projects at Blink usually range from 1-4 months. Most opportunities are full-time, but sometimes part-time needs arise as well. This is a great opportunity to work with a diverse group of clients from various industries.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will bridge content, design, and engineering to deliver modern, AI-enabled content platforms. Lead technical solutioning for clients while remaining deeply hands-on—building proofs of concept, validating architectures, and operationalizing AI-driven content workflows.

What you'll be doing:

    Client-Facing Technical Leadership

  • Partner with clients to shape and validate technical solutions for content modernization and GenAI enablement.

  • Advise on technology stacks, tradeoffs, and implementation approaches (CMS/DAM, front end, APIs, AI services).

  • Translate content strategy and design intent into executable technical plans.

    • Hands-On Delivery & Prototyping

  • Design and build proof-of-concepts that demonstrate feasibility, value, and scalability.

  • Implement front-end integrations with headless CMS/DAM platforms.

  • Build or wire up GenAI workflows (LLM, RAG) into content creation, assembly, and delivery pipelines.

  • Collaborate directly with client and partner (e.g., Mphasis) engineering teams on implementation.

    • AI & Content Enablement

  • Integrate AI-assisted authoring, retrieval, and personalization features into content systems.

  • Define guardrails for AI usage, including privacy, consent, accessibility, and observability.

  • Design evaluation approaches for AI outputs (quality, factuality, tone, accessibility).

    • Quality, Performance & Operations

  • Ensure accessibility (WCAG), performance (Core Web Vitals), and scalability are built in from the start.

  • Define testing strategies for content models, front-end rendering, and AI outputs.

  • Support launch readiness with documentation, runbooks, and defect triage.

    • Practice Growth

  • Act as an internal technical advisor and multiplier.

  • Help define future roles and participate in hiring more specialized engineers as demand grows.

What we are looking for:

    Skills & Experience

    Core Requirements

  • Senior-level, hands-on engineering experience (you still code).

  • Strong front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript); React/Next.js preferred.

  • Experience integrating headless CMS/DAM platforms (e.g., Contentful, AEM Headless, Sitecore).

  • Practical experience working with LLMs, RAG patterns, or AI-driven workflows.

  • Comfort designing APIs, data contracts, and front-end/state management patterns.

  • Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders in a consulting or delivery role.

    • AI & Content Systems

  • Experience embedding AI into content workflows (authoring, assembly, review, personalization).

  • Understanding of evaluation metrics (quality, safety, accessibility) and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Familiarity with privacy, compliance, and accessibility considerations for AI systems.

    • Testing & Quality

  • Experience with front-end testing (unit, integration, UI) and accessibility tooling.

  • Ability to design validation strategies for modular content and AI outputs.

    • Nice to Haves

  • Design systems experience (Storybook, tokens, enterprise component libraries).

  • Performance optimization (SSR/ISR, edge/CDN strategies).

  • Internationalization and localization workflows.

  • Experience with AI observability, cost monitoring, or prompt optimization.

  • CMS-integrated AI evaluation or reviewer dashboards.

About Us:

Blink UX is a design consulting firm creating products that people use, love and remember. Blink has over two decades of experience in UX research, strategy, and design partnering with innovative industry leaders including Amazon, Chase, Gates Foundation, Google, Meta, and NASA. For more information visit blinkux.com.

EEO

When hiring, we aim to build teams of compassionate people with diverse experiences, thoughts, and skills. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual preference, gender identity or age, disability, or length of time spent unemployed.
Following your application submission we encourage you to disclose personal demographic information in order to help us comply with federal and state Equal Employment Opportunity record-keeping requirements. We will also use this information in an anonymous aggregated form to help us measure and improve diversity at Blink.

About Us

Udacity is now an Accenture company, and exciting things are happening! 🚀 We are on a mission of forging futures in tech through radical talent transformation in digital technologies. We offer a unique and immersive online learning platform, powering corporate technical training in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Autonomous Systems, Cloud Computing and more. Our rapidly growing global organization is revolutionizing how the enterprise market bridges the talent shortage and skills gaps during their digital transformation journey.

Recognized for its innovative impact, Udacity part of Accenture continues to empower people with the skills they need to secure the jobs they want.

Our School of Artificial Intelligence is committed to providing high-quality upskilling opportunities in this rapidly evolving field. We regularly launch new projects and are seeking experienced mentors to join us as external contractors to support our programs and learners.

As new initiatives arise, we will reach out to qualified candidates within this talent pool to provide details on project scope, expected timelines, and compensation. If you are passionate about tackling meaningful challenges and making a difference we invite you to apply and explore this opportunity to collaborate with us.

You’ll be an excellent fit if you have:

  • Proven technical expertise with 5+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning
  • A passion for mentoring and helping others succeed in their learning
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. You enjoy building relationships, communicating effectively, and fostering a positive learning environment
  • A deep understanding of the tech industry and emerging trends in AI and related fields
  • The flexibility to work part-time as an external contractor alongside your current commitments

Mandatory Technical Skills – School of AI

  • Proficiency in Python and API integration
  • Strong understanding of core AI/ML concepts
  • Familiarity with LLMs and Generative AI tools
  • Experience with prompt engineering and model evaluation
  • Working knowledge of ML libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow)
  • Exposure to AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)
  • Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector databases
  • Ability to build or support AI-driven applications/workflows
  • Awareness of AI use cases, limitations, and ethics
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Preferred:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Hands-on end-to-end AI/ML or GenAI projects

Responsibilities:

Your responsibilities as a technical mentor will be divided into three major tasks.

  1. 1:1 video calls
  2. Virtual TechnicalDeep-Dive Sessions
  3. Group Q&A sessions

Personal 1:1 Session:

  • Provide personalized support by addressing learner questions related to course content and projects.
  • Prior to the call mentors are expected to review the students' previous project submission(s) - provided by the Mentor Success Team when available - and/or any specific areas of the Nanodegree content or project that the student has expressed confusion or difficulty with.

Technical Deep-Dive Session:

  • For concept deep-dives, mentors will come prepared with a slide presentation that reviews a Nanodegree concept in more detail, share different use-cases for the concept to broaden student perspectives and understanding, and hold a Q&A session with the learners.
  • For project walkthroughs, a mentor will come prepared with a slide presentation that outlines each element of the rubric to help learners understand expectations and typical problem areas they may encounter. This can include a mentor “grading” a sample submission to demonstrate what mentors are looking for when reviewing projects.

Group Q&A Session:

  • Host regular sessions (via Slack or video) to address learner queries related to projects and coursework. No prior preparation required.

Why should you apply?

  • Make an impact by mentoring and contributing to a vibrant, global learning community
  • Showcase your expertise and gain recognition for your technical knowledge
  • Learn and network with our global community of mentors while staying ahead of the curve on cutting-edge technologies
  • Earn additional income with the flexibility to work on your own schedule

Mentoring at Udacity offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of learners and to contribute to achieving our mission.

If you're passionate about learning, technology and want to make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply to become a mentor at Udacity part of Accenture.

Let's work together to shape the future of tech education!

raw.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Recruiting & HR Coordinator

Airspace is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Recruiting and HR Coordinator to help us scale during a period of significant hiring growth. In this role, you'll play a critical part in building our talent pipeline, from sourcing and coordinating candidates through the interview process to supporting their transition into the company, while also lending a hand across core HR operations. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, momentum, and helping build great teams.

Responsibilities:

Recruiting (primary focus)

  • Support full-cycle recruiting for a pipeline of open requisitions, from intake through offer, in partnership with the Senior Corporate Recruiter.
  • Source active and passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, and other sourcing tools.
  • Conduct initial candidate outreach and support early-stage screening calls to confirm basic qualifications.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and logistics, ensuring a smooth and timely candidate experience.
  • Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline status in the ATS.
  • Assist with drafting and posting job requisitions.
  • Support job offer preparation and extension in partnership with the Senior Corporate Recruiter and HR leadership.
  • Help track and report on recruiting pipeline metrics.

HR Support (secondary focus)

  • Assist with onboarding related tasks: background checks, offer letters, and first-day coordination for new hires.
  • Support New Hire Orientation sessions on a recurring basis.
  • Help maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS system.
  • Provide backup support for offboarding processes as needed.
  • Assist with compliance tracking (e.g., state-mandated training completion) across jurisdictions.
  • Partner cross-functionally with department leads to support broader HR needs as they arise.


Requirements:

  • 1–2+ years of experience in Human Resources or related administrative roles.
  • Experience with HRIS systems (Rippling experience is a plus).
  • Proficiency with G-Suite products.
  • Familiarity with compliance and/or benefits administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; approachable, responsive, and solutions-oriented.
  • Knowledge of California wage and labor laws.

Compensation:

  • Pay scale: $23.00 – $27.00/hour
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options.
  • Unlimited PTO policy.
  • Competitive 401k program with employer match.


Success Metrics


Your first year

  • Independently run a full recruitment cycle for 5+ requisitions (both domestic and international).
  • Supports full-cycle coordination across an average of 8-12 open requisitions at any given time.
  • Schedules interviews within 24-48 hours of receiving candidate availability.
  • Maintains accurate data entry of recruitment tracker weekly.
  • Delivers a smooth onboarding experience.

Next year

  • Independently owns full-cycle coordination for 1 requisitions at a time.
  • Sources and delivers an average of 5+ qualified candidates per week into active pipelines.


Your First 90 Days

  • Fully ramped on Greenhouse, Rippling, and LinkedIn Recruiter, working independently in each.
  • Attend at least 3+ Operations shadow sessions to build role/business context.
  • Conduct at least an average of 10 screening calls per week.
  • Supports at least 1 full recruitment cycle start to finish.

Your First 180 Days

  • Conduct at least an average of 10-15 Operations screenings per week.
  • Independently coordinating at least 3-5 open reqs at one time - full recruitment cycle.

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

A friendly reminder: Airspace will only contact candidates from an @airspace.com email, a no-reply notification from , or a verified LinkedIn profile. We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at before responding.

raw.title: Care Specialist
raw.excerpt: Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention.
raw.description:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

Pelago has scaled to helping hundreds of employers and health plans and has already helped more than 750,000 members better manage their substance use. If you're passionate about AI and making an impact on the health of others, join us and make it happen!

Overview of the Role


We are seeking a Care Specialist to join our digital clinic and help members achieve healthier, more fulfilling lives. As the first point of contact, the Care Specialist plays a vital role in creating a welcoming onboarding experience and helping members successfully begin their care journey at Pelago. This role is primarily focused on conducting intake assessments, welcome calls, and initial clinical screenings, educating members on Pelago's care model, and connecting them with the appropriate ongoing care team.

Approximately 70% of this role is dedicated to member onboarding activities, including intakes, welcome calls, and care coordination. The remaining 30% focuses on maintaining a small ongoing caseload and providing flexible clinical support through temporary member coverage, pilot initiatives, and other operational needs. The ideal candidate is clinically strong, adaptable, enjoys variety, and is passionate about improving access to high-quality substance use care.
This is a direct-service, remote clinical role based anywhere in the USA.

In this role you will…
  • Serve as the first clinical point of contact for members entering Pelago, creating a welcoming, supportive onboarding experience.
  • Conduct initial screenings and intake assessments to evaluate behavioral health history, substance use, symptoms, and member goals.
  • Understand all Pelago care pathways, effectively communicate treatment options to members, and guide them toward the most appropriate level of care.
  • Facilitate warm transitions by connecting members with their assigned counselor or coach and sharing relevant clinical information to support continuity of care.
  • Conduct welcome calls and other early member touchpoints to build rapport, answer questions, increase engagement, and ensure a smooth transition into ongoing care.
  • Maintain a small ongoing caseload by providing individual counseling, monitoring progress toward behavior change goals, and supporting members as needed.
  • Provide temporary member coverage during clinician leave, staffing transitions, or other operational needs.
  • Support special projects, pilot programs, and new clinical workflows as needed.
  • Document member interactions thoroughly and contribute to ongoing quality improvement efforts.
  • Utilize evidence-based approaches including CBT, Motivational Interviewing (MI), mindfulness-based interventions, harm reduction techniques, and relapse prevention.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including Product, Clinical, and Operations) to optimize the member experience and inform service improvements.
  • Maintain active licensure(s)/certification(s) in good standing and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.

The background we are looking for...

  • 3+ years of clinical experience working with individuals with substance use disorders, with demonstrated expertise in CBT, MI, and relapse prevention.
  • Hold an active and unrestricted state credential (license/certification), issued via a state credentialing board. Multi-state licensure is preferred.
  • Credentialing recognized by IC&RC or NAADAC is required (e.g., AADC, CAADC, LADC, LCSW with SUD treatment scope, etc.).
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience providing SBIRT care for people with SUDs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
  • Experience in program development and quality assurance in clinical settings.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of managing competing priorities.
  • Technologically proficient with experience leveraging virtual tools for care delivery.
  • Bonus: Experience with research, data analysis, or program evaluation.
  • Reliable home office setup with 50–100 Mbps internet bandwidth and a confidential workspace.

The provided range reflects our US target salary range for this full-time position, which is part of our broader total compensation package, including incentive bonus program, stock options, comprehensive benefits, and incentive pay applicable to eligible roles. Individual pay within the range will vary based on a variety of factors like role-related experience and education, internal pay equity, and other relevant business factors. CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don't improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization's security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Job Overview

The Cloud Operations Engineer is a customer-facing role responsible for assisting with project and deployment tasks in support of CyberSheath Managed Services clients' onboarding and technology initiatives. The successful candidate will engage new clients to understand their architecture, implement CyberSheath solutions and technologies in the environment, and address any potential gaps that may arise.

They will work as part of a project team responsible for the management, support, and migration/implementation projects related to CyberSheath clients' IT systems. The successful candidate will have a detailed understanding of on-premise and cloud-hosted environments across Microsoft (Office 365, Azure), AWS, and Linux platforms, and will apply that knowledge to manage our customers' computing environments.

  • Microsoft and Azure Operations

    • Provision and deliver computer systems and services across both on-premise and cloud-hosted solutions.

    • Administer, patch, and support Linux server environments (RHEL, Rocky/CentOS, Ubuntu) hosted both on-premise and in the cloud.
    • Troubleshoot Linux system, service, and networking issues, including user and permission management, package management, systemd services, and shell scripting.

    AWS Operations

    • Provision, configure, and support AWS workloads, including EC2, S3, IAM, and VPC networking for client environments.

    • Support multi-cloud client environments spanning Azure and AWS, ensuring consistent security and operational standards.

    • Deploy and maintain tools and monitoring agents such as endpoint protection, vulnerability management, log collection, multifactor authentication, RMM, etc.

    • Drive technical implementation tasks to completion by budgeted deadlines.

    Collaboration and Communication

    • Work with internal CyberSheath stakeholders to ensure key tasks and timelines are identified, on time, and on budget.
    • Provide timely updates and feedback to the internal team and clients regarding project status and activities being on-track.
    • Proactively communicate with clients to ensure requests are properly addressed.
    • Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot onboarding implementation issues as they arise.
    • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

  • Minimum of 7+ years' experience in System Administration, including experience with Microsoft Windows Operating Systems, Microsoft Azure Administration, Server Management (Active Directory - Group Policy), Deployment and Migrations.
  • Hands-on Linux system administration experience (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky and/or Ubuntu) including user management, package management, shell scripting, and patching.
  • Working knowledge of AWS core services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC) sufficient to provide baseline operational support.
  • Intermediate networking experience (TCP/IP, routing, SSH, VPN).
  • Knowledge of automation tools and scripting.
  • Knowledge of security tools, such as EDR, SIEM, MFA, DLP, AIP, etc.
  • Great analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot complex systems and problems.
  • Must have exceptional interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills.
  • Amazing organization skills to balance and prioritize workloads.
  • Must be comfortable with leading technical discussions consisting of client and CyberSheath personnel.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and reside within the United States or its Territories.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

  • Working experience with Government flavors of Office 365, Azure, or AWS (including AWS GovCloud).
  • Working experience with the ConnectWise suite of products.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications: AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400.
  • AWS certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02), AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate (SOA-C02), or AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03).
  • Linux certifications: CompTIA Linux+, Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA).
  • Networking and security certifications: Network+, Security+, CCSP.

Work Environment

  • A virtual work environment

  • Travel expectations - Approximately 20%

  • Some on-call, shift, weekend, and evening work

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

$110,000—$127,000 USD

Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Hospital Medicine NICU and ICU is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.
  • Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.
  • Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC (CPC) required or
  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required
  • Additional certifications such as Certified Evaluation and Management Coder (CEMC) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) preferred

We value each customer and understand that people want to do business with people who care. That’s one way we differ from our competitors. We are proud of what we as a team have accomplished. We will always strive for improvement, our motto since day one has been “Success is the only option.”

Lendmark Financial Services offers a comprehensive benefits package for employees and dependents that includes medical, dental, vision benefits, paid time off, paid holidays, 401(k), life insurance, long-term disability, tuition assistance and an employee assistance program. We also offer optional benefits such as critical care, auto, home and pet insurance as well as other ancillary insurance options.

SUMMARY:

The role of Divisional Branch Coordinator, AVP provides support and leadership to Branch Managers within the Division in accordance with Lendmark Financial Services policies and procedures. Ensures that the highest quality of customer service is provided to customers within the Division. Provides Branch Managers with administrative support is areas of compliance, regulations, policies and procedures.

MAJOR DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and monitor delinquency, charge off’s and non-performing assets (20%)

  • Assist in preparation and management of divisional budget (20%)

  • Conduct full/follow - up supervisions on all offices of responsibility according to Lendmark’s policies and procedures and audit standards (20%)

  • Risk assessment of divisional branch operations through their review and analysis of audit and management reports and information (10%)

  • Insure divisional compliance with applicable laws, regulations and company policies and procedures (10%)

  • Responsible for personnel management to include recruitment and selection of evaluating personnel and training and development which will include the administration of the management training program (10%)

  • Assist with acquisitions to include due diligence, employee evaluation and conversion (5%)

  • Other duties as assigned (5%)

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in consumer finance business or related industry

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable education or related training

  • Personnel Management experience

  • Budgeting and industry financial analysis experience

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Ability to work independently

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Ability to deal effectively with other managers and all staff personnel

  • Detail-oriented and Strong analytical skills

  • Ability to travel a considerable amount of time

  • Communicate with Executive Level management in a concise and professional manner

  • Previous experience in divisional management position in consumer finance industry

PREFERRED/DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Previous experience in divisional management position in consumer finance industry

  • Industry educational achievements

  • Transferable

COMPENSATION:

  • The salary range for this position is based on the specific Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and/or Experience of the selected candidate.

  • This position is eligible for Quarterly Incentive compensation based on individual and company performance guidelines.

If you are interested in a fast paced, high growth, team oriented and great culture environment, you'll enjoy a career with us!

raw.title: Клієнт-менеджер/ка (Служба турботи про користувачів)
raw.excerpt: 💫Про RIA. com Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.
raw.description:
💫Про RIA.com

Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com, яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com. Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

Ми шукаємо Клієнт-менеджера в команду Служби турботи про користувачів. На цій позиції ти будеш допомагати клієнтам швидко та якісно вирішувати їхні запити.

🔷Які задачі стоять перед Клієнт-менеджером:
  • Телефонні консультації: відповідає на вхідні та здійснює вихідні дзвінки клієнтів та допомагає у вирішенні їх запитів щодо продуктів компанії: AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com.
  • Письмові консультації: опрацювання звернень від користувачів в чатах та електронній пошті.
  • Сервісні запити: робота з CRM системою Creatio та взаємодія з іншими командами.
В середньому клієнт-менеджер отримує 60-80 звернень за робочий день.

⚡️Тепер про очікування до кандидата, якого шукаємо:
  • Досвід роботи з клієнтами: телефонні консультації або офлайн-взаємодія.
  • Турботливий підхід та емпатія: вміння розуміти потреби клієнта й прагнення допомогти.
  • Орієнтація на високий рівень сервісу: здатність забезпечити якісний клієнтський досвід навіть у складних ситуаціях.
Буде перевагою:
  • Досвід роботи з CRM-системами.
  • Досвід роботи у сфері підтримки клієнтів або контакт-центрі.
🔗Про етапи інтерв'ю:
  • Після відбору твого резюме — телефонний дзвінок з рекрутером.
  • Співбесіда в онлайн форматі з Лідеркою команди та тренером.
  • Запрошення на оплачуване стажування віддалено або в офісі (2-3 тижні)
📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com?
  • Практичне втілення командних цінностей: відкрита комунікація, індивідуальні тренінги з тренером, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.
  • Комфортні умови роботи: віддалений або гібридний формат роботи, плаваючі 8-годинні зміни (4/2; 3/2; 3/1; 2/1) зі стартом між 08:00 та 14:00 та обідньою перервою, офіційне працевлаштування.
  • Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, оплачувані лікарняні та 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки.
  • Можливості розвитку:перехід між категоріями для кар'єрного зростання, отримання бонусів за чітко визначеною системою KPI. Індивідуальні тренінги та участь у внутрішніх конкурсах для розвитку професійних навичок. Компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.
RIA.com — соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA — це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:
що саме команда формує продукти, які стають лідерами ринку, тож чекаємо твоє резюме!

raw.excerpt: Unser Kunde ist einer der führenden Internetanbieter Deutschlands und baut und betreibt ein Glasfasernetz in ländlichen und vorstädtischen Gebieten Deutschlands.
raw.description:
Unser Kunde ist einer der führenden Internetanbieter Deutschlands und baut und betreibt ein Glasfasernetz in ländlichen und vorstädtischen Gebieten Deutschlands. Wir suchen Customer Care Specialists für ein spezialisiertes Team im Bereich Kundenbindung und Vertragsmanagement.

Das Team arbeitet in zwei Kernbereichen: der Bearbeitung von Kündigungen und Widerrufen sowie der Bindung von Kunden durch einen beratenden, bedarfsorientierten Ansatz. Du bist die Stimme, die Kunden verbunden hält — im wörtlichen wie im übertragenen Sinne.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entgegennahme eingehender Anrufe von Bestandskunden mit dem Ziel, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und sie durch echte, beratende Gespräche zu halten

  • Bearbeitung von Kündigungen, Widerrufen und allgemeinen Kundenanliegen — einschließlich Rechnungsanfragen, Tarifanpassungen und Stammdatenänderungen

  • Betreuung eines ausgewählten Kundenstamms und Bearbeitung von Anfragen per Telefon und schriftlich — die Rolle ist überwiegend telefonisch (~85 %), mit einem Anteil an schriftlicher Ticketbearbeitung (~15 %)

  • Arbeit mit mehreren Tools und Plattformen um Kundenanliegen effizient zu lösen und Interaktionen sorgfältig zu dokumentieren

  • Einhaltung von Qualitätsrichtlinien und Beitrag zu Teamzielen in den Bereichen Kundenzufriedenheit, Conversion und Serviceverfügbarkeit

Was wir suchen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau - sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Eine angenehme Stimme und ein klarer, beratender Kommunikationsstil sind essenziell

  • Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise in einer Rolle mit Schwerpunkt Kundenbindung, Upselling oder beratender Verkauf

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - du hörst aktiv zu, drückst dich klar aus und gehst empathisch auf dein Gegenüber ein

  • Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren Softwaretools gleichzeitig - der tägliche Wechsel zwischen verschiedenen Plattformen gehört zum Alltag

  • Eine zuverlässige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise — ob im Homeoffice oder im Büro

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in Schichten von 8:00 – 20:00 Uhr

  • Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an einer strukturierten, 14-tägigen und bezahlten Schulung zu Beginn, bestehend aus einer Kombination aus Präsenztraining im Büro (Zagreb) und Remote-Trainings.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce

  • Kenntnisse in der Telekommunikations- oder Glasfaserbranche

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenbindung oder Rückgewinnungskampagnen

  • Grundkenntnisse in gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Das kannst du erwarten

  • Ein Arbeitgeber, dem dein Arbeitserlebnis und Wohlbefinden wichtig sind

  • Stabiles und wettbewerbsfähiges Einkommen

  • Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice aus ganz Kroatien zu arbeiten

  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage abhängig von der Betriebszugehörigkeit

  • Karriere- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • MultiSport-Mitgliedschaft

  • Ein großartiges, offenes Team, das Transparenz, Vertrauen und Zusammenarbeit lebt

Klingt gut?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
